agents.name: Weather and Atmospheric Intelligence
agents.description: Acquires and standardizes Galveston station meteorology. Rainfall and wind read public NOAA ASOS observations. Other weather variables are registered only.

agents.name: Satellite and Remote Sensing
agents.description: Planned optical, multispectral, thermal, SAR, land-cover, and change-detection products. Commercial map basemaps are not scientific satellite products.

agents.name: Geospatial Survey and Terrain
agents.description: Planned LiDAR, terrain, building, bathymetry, and datum workflows. The existing OSM2World viewer is separate from this agent.

agents.name: Population and Demographics
agents.description: Planned aggregate census statistics. Individual household occupancy will not be inferred.

agents.name: Coastal, Ocean and Hydrology
agents.description: Planned water-level, wave, drainage, and flood products. Static flood zones are not dynamic simulations.

agents.name: Transportation and Mobility
agents.description: Planned network and traffic products. Synthetic demand must stay labeled as synthetic.

agents.name: Urban Infrastructure and Buildings
agents.description: Planned building and infrastructure attributes linked to existing Galveston building identifiers.

agents.name: Energy and Utilities
agents.description: Planned utility research products. Actual grid topology will not be fabricated.

agents.name: Wireless Communications and IoT
agents.description: Planned radio and sensor research. Licensed sites and synthetic deployments stay distinct.

agents.name: Environmental and Ecological Intelligence
agents.description: Planned air, water, soil, wetland, and vegetation products from scientific sources.

agents.name: Seasonal and Climate Intelligence
agents.description: Planned climatology and scenario comparisons. Normals are not forecasts.

agents.name: Community Forums and Public Reports
agents.description: Planned use of authorized public reports only. Reports stay unverified until corroborated, and identities are not collected.

agents.name: Disaster Risk and Emergency Response
agents.description: Planned hazard and response research products. Outputs are non-operational and are not emergency guidance.

agents.name: Autonomous UAV and UGV Operations
agents.description: Planned mission and mobility research. Viewer animation is not a vehicle-dynamics model.

agents.name: Maritime and Port Operations
agents.description: Planned port and vessel products. AIS access must be checked for license before use.

agents.name: Public Health and Exposure
agents.description: Planned aggregate health geography. Individual health profiles are out of scope.

agents.name: Economic Activity and Land Use
agents.description: Planned aggregate economic statistics. Modeled estimates stay distinct from published statistics.

agents.name: Scenario and Experiment Orchestration
agents.description: Builds reproducible scenario manifests from datasets that are already in the catalog. It does not invent measurements, choose unstated model parameters, or launch a numerical model.

agents.name: Data Discovery
agents.description: Searches the local catalog by agent, variable, time, source, and data kind. It does not crawl providers that are not connected.

agents.name: Data Quality
agents.description: Records missing values, traces, range flags, units, and the limits of a station observation.

agents.name: Data Fusion
agents.description: Checks whether datasets may be combined. It refuses incompatible units, meanings, and undocumented station-to-grid broadcasts.

agents.name: Provenance
agents.description: Stores source, acquisition time, methodology, processing version, parent dataset, and license.

agents.name: Visualization
agents.description: Publishes station series as Cesium point markers with units, time, and source labels. It does not draw a city-wide surface from one station.

agents.name: Validation
agents.description: Compares a processed series with an independent dataset when one is supplied. It does not claim validation without that reference.

agents.name: Experiment Reporting
agents.description: Exports the scenario manifest, dataset contracts, and quality notes that were actually stored.

weather.name: Rainfall
weather.description: Station precipitation from routine ASOS reports. The implemented variable is hourly accumulation, not rainfall intensity and not a spatial rainfall field.

supported_variables.name: Hourly precipitation accumulation
supported_variables.note: ASOS p01i is the accumulation over the hour ending at the report time.

supported_variables.name: Rainfall intensity
supported_variables.note: Not derived in this version, so accumulation is not relabeled as intensity.

supported_variables.name: Daily precipitation
supported_variables.note: Daily totals are not summed here because sub-hourly reports would double-count p01i.

supported_variables.name: Radar-estimated precipitation
supported_variables.note: MRMS is not connected. Radar estimates will not be substituted for gauge reports.

supported_variables.name: Forecast precipitation
supported_variables.note: Forecast grids are a different data kind and are not mixed into this observation series.

required_parameters: time_range or an explicit historical preset
weather.geographic_coverage: Galveston Scholes Field ASOS (KGLS / IEM GLS), a point outside the downtown study polygon.
weather.temporal_coverage: IEM serves historical routine hourly reports. The NOAA NWS API serves recent observations and often omits precipitation for this station.
processing_requirements: Preserve trace as a flag rather than a depth.
Do not fill missing hours with zero.
Do not resample onto clock-hour timestamps.
simulation_compatibility: Single-station hourly accumulation can be inspected or used later as a comparison series.
It is not a gridded hydrologic forcing product.

weather.name: Wind
weather.description: Station wind speed, direction, and gust. Direction is the meteorological direction the wind is coming from. This is not a vertical wind profile.

supported_variables.name: Wind direction
supported_variables.note: Calm reports store a null direction. Zero degrees with nonzero speed means north.

supported_variables.name: Wind gust
supported_variables.note: Missing gusts stay missing. They are not copied from the sustained wind.

supported_variables.name: Vertical wind profile
supported_variables.note: ASOS and the NWS station observation do not provide a profile.

weather.geographic_coverage: Galveston Scholes Field ASOS (KGLS / IEM GLS), a point outside the downtown study polygon.
weather.temporal_coverage: NOAA NWS API: recent observations. IEM ASOS: historical routine hourly reports.
processing_requirements: Convert knots or kilometres per hour to metres per second with exact factors.
Do not treat the display height in Cesium as an anemometer height.
simulation_compatibility: Suitable as a station time series for later UAV wind-input work.
This version does not write a UAV simulator file or a spatial wind field.

orchestration.geographic_coverage: Regions declared on the attached datasets.
orchestration.temporal_coverage: Time spans declared on the attached datasets.
simulation_compatibility: Numerical simulation engines are not configured.

orchestration.name: Experiment Gaps
orchestration.description: Lists inputs that a rainfall-and-coastal flood experiment still lacks.
simulation_compatibility: Reports gaps. It does not run a flood model or fill the gaps with synthetic water.

data_discovery.name: Data Discovery
data_discovery.description: Searches the local catalog by agent, variable, time, source, and data kind. It does not crawl providers that are not connected.
data_discovery.geographic_coverage: Applies to datasets in the catalog.
data_discovery.temporal_coverage: Applies to datasets in the catalog.

data_quality.name: Data Quality
data_quality.description: Records missing values, traces, range flags, units, and the limits of a station observation.
data_quality.geographic_coverage: Applies to datasets in the catalog.
data_quality.temporal_coverage: Applies to datasets in the catalog.

data_fusion.name: Data Fusion
data_fusion.description: Checks whether datasets may be combined. It refuses incompatible units, meanings, and undocumented station-to-grid broadcasts.
data_fusion.geographic_coverage: Applies to datasets in the catalog.
data_fusion.temporal_coverage: Applies to datasets in the catalog.

provenance.name: Provenance
provenance.description: Stores source, acquisition time, methodology, processing version, parent dataset, and license.
provenance.geographic_coverage: Applies to datasets in the catalog.
provenance.temporal_coverage: Applies to datasets in the catalog.

visualization.name: Visualization
visualization.description: Publishes station series as Cesium point markers with units, time, and source labels. It does not draw a city-wide surface from one station.
visualization.geographic_coverage: Applies to datasets in the catalog.
visualization.temporal_coverage: Applies to datasets in the catalog.

validation.name: Validation
validation.description: Compares a processed series with an independent dataset when one is supplied. It does not claim validation without that reference.
validation.geographic_coverage: Applies to datasets in the catalog.
validation.temporal_coverage: Applies to datasets in the catalog.

experiment_reporting.name: Experiment Reporting
experiment_reporting.description: Exports the scenario manifest, dataset contracts, and quality notes that were actually stored.
experiment_reporting.geographic_coverage: Applies to datasets in the catalog.
experiment_reporting.temporal_coverage: Applies to datasets in the catalog.
